summary.text: Brendan Clarke is the Family First candidate for Morwell at the 2026 Victorian election, according to both the ABC guide and the party's candidate list. A Family First candidate with the same name stood for Morwell in 2022, winning 1.7% of the primary vote, and for the neighbouring seat of Narracan at its supplementary election in January 2023; the sources don't confirm that this is the same man. Neither the party nor the ABC had published a biography as at early November 2026.

summary.text: Casey Murphy is One Nation's candidate for Morwell at the 2026 Victorian election. She is a Latrobe Valley mother and community advocate who has worked as a youth worker. She ran for One Nation at the January 2023 Narracan supplementary election, taking 6 per cent of first preferences.

prior_roles.note: The ABC says she has been a youth worker; it doesn't say whether she still is.

previous_candidacies.note: The Narracan election was declared failed after the death of a candidate, and a supplementary election was held in January 2023.

summary.text: Martin Cameron is the Nationals MP for Morwell, a seat he won at the 2022 state election when Russell Northe retired. He has been a shadow assistant minister for energy affordability and for small business, and became the Nationals' whip in the Assembly in 2026. He is recontesting Morwell in 2026.

summary.text: Natalie Acreman is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Morwell at the 2026 Victorian election. She grew up in the Latrobe Valley and says the Hazelwood mine fire led her to socialism. She has been secretary of Socialist Alternative at RMIT and led Extinction Rebellion's students and youth group, and she was second on the party's Eastern Victoria Region ticket in 2022.

prior_roles.role: Leader of the students and youth subgroup

priorities.text: Fully funded hospitals, schools and community support services
Ending regional Victoria's neglect by the major parties
Easing rent and mortgage pressure on working-class households
Migrants didn’t cause the housing crisis.

summary.text: Rochelle Hine is the Greens candidate for Morwell at the 2026 Victorian election. A health professional and academic with Monash Rural Health, she has more than three decades in rural health and previously worked as a social work clinician. She stood for the Greens in Morwell in 2022 and in the federal seat of Gippsland in 2025.

The ABC's guide gave no biography for this candidate as at 9 Nov 2026.

summary.text: Tracie Lund is Labor's candidate for Morwell at the 2026 Victorian election. She ran for Morwell as an independent at the 2014, 2018 and 2022 state elections, and sat on the City of Latrobe council from 2020 until she resigned in March 2026, serving for a time as deputy mayor. She managed the Morwell Neighbourhood House for 13 years and has lived in the area since 2011.

prior_roles.note: The ABC says she held the role for 13 years; neither source gives the years.

Good services and opportunities close to home for families
